business_summary.text: Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients Limited is a leading manufacturer of synthetic food colors and specialty ingredients, serving diverse industries including food, pharmaceuticals, and cosmetics with a global footprint across 80 countries.

call_points.text: Management expects meaningful new revenue streams from strategic initiatives like Coat Icon and two new projects.
EBITDA margin expanded by ~400 bps due to shift towards cosmetic dyes and value-added products.
Expansion into tablet coatings via Coat Icon marks a strategic milestone.
Pilot plant at Roha (Arjun Foods) is ready; product is under sampling stage.
Pilot plant at Dahej is ready; product sampling to begin soon.
Q2 performance improved due to an increase in demand.
Company exports to more than 80 countries across 6 continents.
Management expects meaningful new revenue streams from strategic initiatives like Coat Icon and two new projects under development.
EBITDA margin expanded by ~400 bps YoY due to favourable product mix shift towards higher-margin specialty products.
New project at Dahej involves ₹75-85 Cr capex, targeting ₹125-150 Cr sales.
High-margin product contribution expected to double to 10-12% in FY27.
Pharma coating (CoatIcon) scale-up requires ₹5-12 Cr outflow.
Management expects full utilization of Dahej and Roha facilities in FY27.
Interest coverage fell due to withdrawal of export finance subvention.
U.S. market sales were impacted by volatile tariff policies since Jan 2025.
R&D team includes 60+ chemists and multiple PhDs across two facilities.

timeline.summary: Q4FY26 results (consolidated): revenue ₹122.68 Cr (+12.0% YoY), net profit ₹13.15 Cr (+10.5% YoY).
Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients reported FY26 PAT growth of 13% to ₹49 Cr and announced the commencement of its 350 TPM Dahej SEZ Phase-I plant.
Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients Limited shared the Q4 & FY2026 earnings call recording on May 14, 2026, via its website.
Vidhi Specialty announced a ₹75-85 Cr capex plan for a new high-margin product line at Dahej during its Q4FY26 earnings call.
Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients reported Q1FY27 results with revenue of ₹146.3 Cr, up 66.4% YoY, and PAT of ₹17.1 Cr, up 34.7% YoY, driven by higher demand and a shift to higher-margin products.
Q2FY27 results (consolidated): revenue ₹136.51 Cr (+82.0% YoY), net profit ₹17.62 Cr (+66.9% YoY).
Vidhi Specialty Food Ingredients reported Q2FY27 revenue of ₹136.5 Cr and PAT of ₹17.6 Cr, highlighting a strategic shift toward higher-margin specialty products.
